# Variety

> > Variety delivers entertainment industry analysis covering box office performance, streaming strategy, AI copyright issues, and the evolving creator economy.

Variety's VIP+ premium content provides in-depth analysis of film, television, streaming, gaming, and music industry trends. The publication covers major studios like Disney, Warner Bros., and Netflix, examining business strategies, talent compensation, and emerging technologies reshaping entertainment.

## Key Topics

- Box office analysis and theatrical releases
- Streaming viewership and platform strategy
- AI copyright and content licensing
- Creator economy and YouTube dynamics
- Gaming IP adaptations
- Music catalog acquisitions
- Film financing models
- Anime streaming market
- CTV and advertising technology
- Transmedia and franchise development
- Talent compensation
- Holiday and summer movie scheduling
- Broadway adaptations
- Studio Ghibli and animation
- Billion-dollar box office performers
